### `GET /api/deployments/{deployment_version_id}/telemetry`

**Get Telemetry**

Aggregate latency / error rate / token throughput over a window. Returns zeroed payload when no samples have been ingested — push samples via `POST .../telemetry/ingest` first.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deployment_version_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |

### `POST /api/deployments/{deployment_version_id}/drift/check`

**Trigger Drift Check**

Re-run gold-set scoring against a deployed model. Two prediction sources: pass `predictions` for the offline replay path (recommended for production — bring your own inference client), or pass `endpoint_url` for the narrow live-HTTP proof of concept (hard-coded `{prompt}` shape; will not work against HF/SageMaker/vLLM without transformation).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deployment_version_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type: `application/json` — `DriftCheckRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gold_set_id` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `eval_type` | `string` | no |  |
| `tolerance` | `number` | no |  |
| `max_samples` | `integer` | no |  |
| `predictions` | `DriftPredictionEntry[] \\| null` | no |  |
| `endpoint_url` | `string \\| null` | no |  |
| `endpoint_headers` | `object \\| null` | no |  |
| `notes` | `string \\| null` | no |  |
| `actor` | `string \\| null` | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `any` | Successful Response |
| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |

### `POST /api/deployments/{deployment_version_id}/telemetry/ingest`

**Ingest Telemetry**

Push-only telemetry. The deployment plane has no built-in scraper, so every sample must be POSTed here by your own inference client or a provider-side scrape sidecar. See `served_model_telemetry_service` docstring for wiring patterns.
